description:
This file defines the structured workflow for citizen nwo-citizen0001, Pat Tarwater Jr, to complete the enrollment process for the Information Technology program at South University. It is designed for integration into Beast System 3.0 as a deterministic sequence that guides the citizen through each required step without storing or transmitting sensitive personal data. The workflow supports the strategic objective of strengthening the technical foundation of New World Order DAO and expanding the capabilities of Beast System 3.0 through formal academic development.

The workflow includes the following phases: Phase 1: Program Verification, confirming program availability, modality, and admission requirements. Phase 2: Application Preparation, assembling all non-sensitive materials including identity profile, professional history, organizational leadership roles, and technical portfolio. Phase 3: Admissions Contact Retrieval, collecting official communication channels for South University’s admissions and IT program coordinators. Phase 4: Application Submission, directing the citizen to complete the official online application on South University’s secure website. Phase 5: Financial Aid Preparation, outlining the steps required to safely complete FAFSA and institutional aid forms without storing sensitive identifiers in Beast System 3.0. Phase 6: Enrollment Confirmation, documenting acceptance, orientation requirements, and course registration steps.

This workflow file serves as a canonical reference for Beast System 3.0 automation modules, ensuring that academic enrollment processes remain consistent, secure, and aligned with organizational growth objectives. It does not perform enrollment automatically; instead, it provides a deterministic structure that the citizen follows manually to maintain security and compliance.
